verses.zh: 诡诈的天平为耶和华所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。
verses.kjv: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
verses.en: The LORD hates a scale that cheats, but an honest weight makes him glad.

verses.zh: 骄傲来，羞耻也来；谦逊人却有智慧。
verses.kjv: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
verses.en: When pride comes, shame comes with it, but humble people have wisdom.

verses.zh: 正直人的纯正必引导自己；奸诈人的乖僻必毁灭自己。
verses.kjv: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
verses.en: Honest people are guided by being honest, but cheats are destroyed by their own crookedness.

verses.zh: 发怒的日子资财无益；惟有公义能救人脱离死亡。
verses.kjv: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.en: Money is no help on the day of anger, but doing right saves a person from death.

verses.zh: 完全人的义必指引他的路；但恶人必因自己的恶跌倒。
verses.kjv: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.en: Doing right makes a whole-hearted person's path straight, but bad people fall over their own badness.

verses.zh: 正直人的义必拯救自己；奸诈人必陷在自己的罪孽中。
verses.kjv: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
verses.en: Honest people are rescued by doing right, but cheats are trapped by their own greed.

verses.zh: 恶人一死，他的指望必灭绝；罪人的盼望也必灭没。
verses.kjv: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
verses.en: When a bad person dies, everything they expected dies too; all they hoped for comes to nothing.

verses.zh: 义人得脱离患难，有恶人来代替他。
verses.kjv: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
verses.en: A good person is brought safely out of trouble, and the bad person ends up there instead.

verses.zh: 不虔敬的人用口败坏邻舍；义人却因知识得救。
verses.kjv: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
verses.en: A person who pretends can ruin a neighbour with their mouth, but knowing things rescues good people.

verses.zh: 义人享福，合城喜乐；恶人灭亡，人都欢呼。
verses.kjv: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.en: When good people do well, the whole city is glad; when bad people fall, people shout for joy.

verses.zh: 城因正直人祝福便高举，却因邪恶人的口就倾覆。
verses.kjv: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.en: A city is lifted up by the blessing of honest people, but pulled down by the mouths of bad ones.

verses.zh: 藐视邻舍的，毫无智慧；明哲人却静默不言。
verses.kjv: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
verses.en: Looking down on your neighbour shows no sense; someone who understands keeps quiet.

verses.zh: 往来传舌的，泄漏密事；心中诚实的，遮隐事情。
verses.kjv: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
verses.en: A gossip gives away secrets, but someone trustworthy keeps a matter hidden.

verses.zh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。
verses.kjv: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.en: Without good advice a people falls, but with many advisers there is safety.

verses.zh: 为外人作保的，必受亏损；恨恶击掌的，却得安稳。
verses.kjv: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
verses.en: Promising to pay a stranger's debt brings loss, but refusing to shake on it keeps you safe.

verses.zh: 恩德的妇女得尊荣；强暴的男子得资财。
verses.kjv: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
verses.en: A kind woman is honoured, and forceful men get rich.

verses.zh: 仁慈的人善待自己；残忍的人扰害己身。
verses.kjv: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
verses.en: A kind person does themselves good, but a cruel person brings trouble on themselves.

verses.zh: 恶人经营，得虚浮的工价；撒义种的，得实在的果效。
verses.kjv: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
verses.en: A bad person earns empty wages, but whoever plants what is right gets a real reward.

verses.zh: 恒心为义的，必得生命；追求邪恶的，必致死亡。
verses.kjv: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
verses.en: Sticking to what is right leads to life; chasing what is evil leads to death.

verses.zh: 心中乖僻的，为耶和华所憎恶；行事完全的，为他所喜悦。
verses.kjv: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
verses.en: The LORD hates a twisted heart, but he delights in people who live whole and straight.

verses.zh: 恶人虽然连手，必不免受罚；义人的后裔必得拯救。
verses.kjv: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
verses.en: Be sure of this: bad people will not go unpunished, but the children of good people will be safe.

verses.zh: 妇女美貌而无见识，如同金环带在猪鼻上。
verses.kjv: As a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
verses.en: A beautiful woman with no sense is like a gold ring in a pig's nose.

verses.zh: 义人的心愿尽得好处；恶人的指望致干忿怒。
verses.kjv: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.en: What good people want ends in good; what bad people expect ends in anger.

verses.zh: 有施散的，却更增添；有吝惜过度的，反致穷乏。
verses.kjv: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
verses.en: One person gives freely and gets more; another holds back too much and ends up poor.

verses.zh: 好施舍的，必得丰裕；滋润人的，必得滋润。
verses.kjv: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
verses.en: A generous person will do well; whoever gives others a drink will be given one.

verses.zh: 屯粮不卖的，民必咒诅他；情愿出卖的，人必为他祝福。
verses.kjv: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
verses.en: People curse whoever hoards grain, but they bless whoever is willing to sell it.

verses.zh: 恳切求善的，就求得恩惠；惟独求恶的，恶必临到他身。
verses.kjv: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
verses.en: Whoever works hard at doing good finds kindness, but whoever looks for trouble will get it.

verses.zh: 倚仗自己财物的，必跌倒；义人必发旺，如青叶。
verses.kjv: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
verses.en: Whoever leans on their money will fall, but good people grow green like a leaf.

verses.zh: 扰害己家的，必承受清风；愚昧人必作慧心人的仆人。
verses.kjv: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.en: Whoever brings trouble on their own family inherits nothing but wind, and a fool ends up serving the wise.

verses.zh: 义人所结的果子就是生命树；有智慧的，必能得人。
verses.kjv: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
verses.en: What a good person grows is a tree of life, and a wise person wins others over.

verses.zh: 看哪，义人在世尚且受报，何况恶人和罪人呢？
verses.kjv: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
verses.en: Look — if good people get what is coming to them here on earth, how much more bad people and sinners!
